steps.caption: Compose a Google update
steps.narration: Approved items publish at the pace you set. Here is how the schedule spreads them out.

steps.value: Clear gutters keep meltwater off your fascia. Fall clean-out slots are open now.
steps.caption: Write a post
steps.narration: Write the posts the schedule will space out.

steps.caption: Add post to draft batch
steps.narration: Choose Add post to draft batch.

steps.value: Snow is coming. Book a free 21-point roof check before winter.
steps.caption: Write the next post
Add it too
steps.narration: And add it too. Spacing applies to the posts in the draft batch.

steps.caption: Schedule and approve
steps.narration: Under Schedule and approve, First publish is when the first item goes out. Blank means now.

steps.caption: First publish
steps.narration: Set a date and a time.

steps.caption: Items per period
steps.narration: Items per period and Cadence spread the rest: three per week, say.

steps.caption: Per week
steps.narration: Choose Per week. Custom times gives every item its own time instead.

steps.caption: Closed hours move items to later days
steps.narration: Cadence sets elapsed spacing, and closed hours can move an item to a later day.

steps.caption: Business hours only
steps.narration: Tick Business hours only to publish only while you are open.

steps.caption: Timezone
steps.narration: Type the location's time zone. These hours are set here, not read from Google.

steps.caption: Opening and closing hour
steps.narration: Set the Opening hour and the Closing hour.

steps.caption: Weekdays
steps.narration: And tick the weekdays. Untick Fri, and nothing publishes on a Friday.

steps.caption: Approve & queue post
steps.narration: Choose Approve and queue post, and both posts are queued on that schedule.

steps.caption: Each item has its own time
steps.narration: Each one shows its own publish time in Calendar, queue and history.

youtube.title: How to set the publishing pace and business hours | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: How Posts & Photos in ConstructHUB spaces out the items you approved: a first publish time, items per day or per week or custom times, and business hours with your time zone, opening and closing hour and weekdays. The schedule spreads what you approved; it does not write new posts.
